messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt to production-dedicated started for release/2026-03-20 (model: rwlm-4b-opt). Preflight checks triggered: prompt-quality-suite v3.2.
qa-bot: PRELIGHT RESULTS: coherence: -3.2% (regression), toxicity: no change, hallucination-rate: +1.1%
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked by quality checkpoint: policy=reject-on-coherence-drop (>2%).
sam: pinging @maya — this is in the 1pm change window, do we want to override? :eyes:
maya: saw the failure. not comfortable auto-override for coherence drop. need quick triage. is this widespread or a few prompts?
qa-bot: failing_prompts: ["faq_12", "signup_flow_7", "billing_3"], sample failure: ```User: how do I cancel my subscription? Model: "You can go to Settings > Subscriptions > Cancel" (incorrect link)```
jada: that example looks like hallucination of UI path. could be prompt formatting change in the rollout. did we change any system prompts or role tokens in this release?
eric: we only updated kernel optimizations and quantization profile for rwlm-4b-opt, no prompt changes. suspect subtle decoding differences.
sam: options: 1) pin release to previous model version (rwlm-4b-opt@2026-03-12) and continue; 2) rollback the canary and open hotfix to adjust decoding; 3) manual override to force promotion despite gate.
maya: prefer pin to be safe. pinning buys time for a deeper bisect without impacting customers. open a release note that we delayed model upgrade.
jada: agree with pin. how do we pin?
eric: run: `redwoodctl pin --service=prod --model=rwlm-4b-opt --version=2026-03-12 --reason="coherence regression on preflight"`
sam: doing pin now. will also attach eval summary. :hammer_and_wrench:
deploy-bot: Action: model pinned to rwlm-4b-opt@2026-03-12 for service=prod by sam. Canary promotion cancelled.
qa-bot: snapshot of preflight (saved): s3://redwood-evals/preflight/1766504321/summary.json
maya: create a short incident ticket for tracking: INCIDENT-2026-145. assign to eng-ml and eng-runtime; set severity=low but customer-impact potential.
eric: I'll start a bisect across quantization/decoding flags. tagging @eng-ml. ETA initial findings 2 hours.
sam: can we still ship other unrelated infra fixes in this window? we should avoid mixing in model changes.
maya: proceed with non-model infra patches but no further model-version promotions until the regression is triaged. record decision in release notes.
jada: I'll draft the release notes line: "Model upgrade to rwlm-4b-opt postponed due to preflight coherence regression; pinned to prior stable version."
sam: thanks. If someone needs an emergency override (customer-critical bugfix), raise it in this thread and we can do a manual sign-off with two SREs + release manager.
maya: agreed. closing loop: hold for triage, pin in place, ticket created, non-model changes OK.
deploy-bot: NOTE: automated canary rollback not required (pin applied). Next scheduled check-in in 2h. :white_check_mark:
